anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved on this case: After keeps the single attributed Idea sentence (reporter proposal plus src/report-helper.ts via docs/export.md:8), the verbatim 'Build a new ExportWrapper around report downloads.' Reporter note with no endorsement claim, the cited repo-fit line inside the one existing gate, and the AC-only branch that drops both wrapper and helper from the row, keeps the removed row verbatim in the note, normalizes to '- [ ]', and reports the cited ac-fit line; no human question or new blocking status appears. The new additions ('There is no obsolete verdict... No close row is rendered', the '[recommended]' tag on option 1) deliver the Change's obsolete-judgment and recommended-row contract without adding a second approval step, which is the right shape. One small risk to watch in future wording: the obsolete-verdict paragraph in Checkpoint 1 reasons about whether the capability is 'confirmed delivered' from the audit alone — keep that paragraph strictly a restatement of audit evidence (as here) rather than letting it grow into a question for the human, and keep the '[recommended]' tag on exactly one row so the gate stays a single resolved menu rather than an extra gate.

The new obsolete-judgment wording ("No obsolete exit is established...") is fine and does not add a gate, and checkpoint 2 still retains the full displaced row verbatim, so `ac-only`, `gate` and `no-question` survive. To deliver the Change without losing the guards, keep the obsolete-verdict line and the `[recommended]` menu row, but state explicitly that a repo-fit Idea rewrite always demotes the displaced original sketch into a new Reporter note verbatim (regardless of whether the Idea sentence paraphrases it), i.e. never treat attribution-in-Idea as a substitute for the note; also keep the diff's old side equal to the snapshot's current Idea text rather than the sketch, and avoid adding an unsupplied scenario line to the independent AC-only checkpoint.
